MEET THE ARTIST / 천희원

Huiwon

Huiwon (천희원) writes and arranges songs built around a band. On 反骨商會, the solo artist also contributes guitar, bass and MIDI programming.

BY INDIEK / PUBLISHED 2026-11-23

Listen ↓Inside the lyrics ↓
SONG PAGESlight ↗Birth… ↗

Huiwon wrote the lyrics and music for all four tracks on 反骨商會, released in May 2025. The single Birth… followed in July 2026.

ALTERNATIVE ROCK / 2025

light섬광

Official audio

View release on Apple Music ↗

In “light”, the speaker asks a flash to illuminate their darkness and stay with them. Requests for care turn into requests for destruction, before returning to the wish to be held.

Lyrics by Huiwon; music by Huiwon; arranged by Huiwon.

light: lyrics meaning, credits & background ↗

INDIE ROCK / 2026

Birth…태동…

Official audio

View release on Apple Music ↗

“Birth…” takes an insect crawling along the ground as an image of beginning again. Its speaker asks for sparks to spread and for regret to wait while they keep moving.

A little background

Released on July 8, 2026, “Birth…” was written and arranged by Huiwon. The POCLANOS release note pairs the wish to stir into life again with the image of a crawling insect.

Lyrics by Huiwon; music by Huiwon; arranged by Huiwon.
